title: Pointing AI at archives found a forgotten meteorite, lost rhinos, and more
summary: The author used AI tools to search through 400 years of historical archives, making fascinating discoveries including a forgotten meteorite, lost rhinos, and other hidden historical gems that would be nearly impossible to find through manual research.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of manually searching through massive historical archives to find relevant or interesting information across centuries of records.
why_valuable: It demonstrates how AI can democratize access to historical archives and uncover hidden connections and discoveries that would be impractical or impossible to find through traditional research methods.
